verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents several public APIs: the Track and Pipelines APIs for data in, and the App API for broadcasts, transactional messages and data fetches. It publishes an OpenAPI spec covering the Track, App and Design Studio APIs, which a probe confirmed is live, plus a Postman collection and a CLI that wraps the Journeys and Pipelines APIs with structured JSON and self-describing schemas. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API, and evidence that API coverage matches the full UI surface (e.g., building automations directly via REST).
